title: SSC Delhi Police Constable Executive Result 2026 – Out
intro: Short Information : Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the result for the Delhi Police Constable (Executive) posts after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 7,201 posts. Applications for the SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 22 September 2025 to 31 October 2025. The examination was held from 18 December 2025 to 06 January 2026. Candidates are advised to regularly check the Sarkari Result portal for updates regarding the SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) Result 2026, which will be uploaded shortly.
applicationFee: Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
